title: Swedish ghost rockets and Doolittle's investigation
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Swedish ghost rockets and Doolittle's investigation, about 1946-1947 at Sweden, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 1946 and 7, there were these ghost rockets showing up in Sweden. They looked like these modified V2s. you had over a thousand sightings of these. And so again, not disputed that Eisenhower sent uh General James Doolittle out to investigate that.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1946 and 1947 people in Sweden reported over a thousand sightings of what were called ghost rockets, which looked like modified V2s, the rockets Germany built in the Second World War. He says it is not disputed that the American general Dwight Eisenhower sent another general, James Doolittle, to investigate. He tells it to show that top military leaders were looking into strange objects in the sky even before the famous UFO wave of the late 1940s.
